messages:
maria: FYI seeing intermittent egress packet loss from rack-r2 -> noticed 3x latency spikes on dedicated slices this morning. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/egress/rack-r2 :warning:
ajohnson: alerted — do we know if it's noisy neighbor (GPU) vs network? any pod churn?
maria: pods fairly stable. kvcache spiking then dropping. infra-bot: [ALERT] egress_loss=6.7% duration=4m rack=rack-r2
samir: can you paste the quick logs from the proxy? small window helps.
maria: log snippet:
```
2026-02-18T09:12:01Z proxy[rack-r2]: tx_queue_drop=12 rx_err=0 tx_latency_p50=18ms tx_latency_p99=420ms
2026-02-18T09:12:05Z scheduler: slot_requeue=3 allocated_to=tenant-3412
2026-02-18T09:12:08Z kvcache: miss_rate=0.83 hit_rate=0.17
```
olga: that kvcache miss rate is huge — could be warm pool churn or slab eviction. any recent warmup jobs?
maria: we rolled a small alloc change at 08:50 to favor fractional slices on rack-r2 (to reduce cost). suspected side-effect.
kevin: that could increase cache pressure. costs saved but latency hit. we need a short-term isolation playbook: pin noisy tenants or route to fallback racks.
ajohnson: agree. build two quick mitigations: 1) proactive routing fallback for high-e2e-latency requests, 2) temporary carveout dedicated warm slots for affected tenants. can infra team run a canary?
samir: i'm happy to run canary. plan: mark tenants with sustained >200ms p99, steer new allocs off rack-r2, and carveout 2 warm slots for top tenants. will test with 10% traffic first. command to trigger steer:
```
infractl route steer --from-rack rack-r2 --to-rack rack-r5 --pct 10 --reason "egress_loss"
```
maria: runbook we should follow: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/noisy-neighbor-isolation — steps 1–4.
olga: long term: re-evaluate fractional slice change; maybe add kvcache soft-reserve to warm pool config. I'll open a TODO in infra-config.
kevin: also call out cost tradeoff: carving warm slots increases spend ~0.7% for rack. acceptable for SLA.
infra-bot: schedule created: canary-job-1746008888 by samir at 1746008950
ajohnson: samir please post canary results here after 10m. if p99 improves by >30% roll to 50%.
samir: started canary at 1746008955. initial 2m: p99 down from 420ms -> 310ms, kvcache hit up to 0.33. continuing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: thanks. i'm standing by to carveout dedicated slices if no improvement. ping me for an immediate rollback of the fractional slice change.
kevin: small note for capacity planning: if we keep carving warm slots on fallback racks, update the monthly reserved capacity forecast with +1GPUs for eu-west. I'll update the forecast doc.
ajohnson: good. after canary we should schedule a deeper postmortem (metrics + cost delta). for now let's keep traffic steering thresholds aggressive.
samir: canary hit 10m -> p99 steady ~280ms, miss_rate -> 0.22. pushing to 50% now. will report final in ~5m.
maria: perfect. tagging @ops-oncall for awareness. :thumbsup:
